{{Quote|My metal friends, this is your lucky day. These two Fulstar plates just came in.|Zilnor, to C-3PO and R2-D2|<ref name="Star Wars Adventures in Colors and Shapes">''[[Star Wars Adventures in Colors and Shapes]]''</ref>}}
'''Zilnor''' was a scruffy [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] who worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. On one occasion, he helped [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] find [[Fulstar plate]]s. He wore an [[Eye patch/Legends|eye patch]] over his left [[Eye/Legends|eye]].
